verdict.rationale: Skyfire publishes an official MCP server (mcp.skyfire.xyz/mcp, with a sandbox variant) documented with specific tools (find-sellers, create-kya-token, create-pay-token, create-kya-payment-token) and auth via the skyfire-api-key header, letting an agent discover sellers and execute commerce workflows directly. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP server works as documented and broader ecosystem adoption evidence.
